variants.text: A round is walked with a rod, and the rod is the woodward's, and the woodward has it. Pacing it out will put you eighty yards wrong, which is the whole of the problem.
The marks are further out than the survey and the survey is not wrong. Something has been moving them, outward, slowly, and re-cutting the faces as it goes.
Four hundred years of quarterly payment to a post nobody has filled in living memory, and the work is being done.
